user.title: Choose a line
user.description:
Pick a tram or bus line of the Bordeaux network. Start typing to filter the list (e.g. "Tram B", "Bus 15").

Unofficial community integration, not affiliated with TBM, Keolis or Bordeaux Métropole.

stop.title: Choose a stop
stop.description: Stops served by {line}. Start typing the stop name to filter the list.

direction.title: Choose a direction
direction.description: {line} at {stop}: which way are you going?

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Bordeaux Métropole open data real-time API. Try again in a moment.
error.no_lines: The TBM API did not return any line.
error.no_stops: No stop could be found for this line. Try again later.
error.invalid_choice: Pick an entry from the list.

abort.already_configured: This stop and direction are already followed for this line.
